channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jaxson Hayes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jaxson Hayes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
I asked him if he felt the same way about Marcus Smart:

“I could definitely see Marcus being a coach. I feel like him- (Hayes paused).”

Marcus Smart on Jaxson Hayes, Apr 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes' ankle injury:

“He tweaked his ankle. Ankle soreness. He had tweaked it when we were here last week, so it's just a re-tweak. He felt on it and it's sore.”

JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes, Dec 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
After the Lakers’ win, head coach JJ Redick revealed that Deandre Ayton was available to return but he stayed away from his to be cautious with Jaxson Hayes and Jarred Vanderbilt playing well in his absence.

“He just had some middle back spasms. He was available in the fourth quarter when he came back out. He had a heat pack on, but I just felt that it wasn’t worth it given that group with Jaxson and Vando at the five, rotating between them in the second half, they were really good. Just didn’t want to risk it with Ayton,”

JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Jaxson Hayes, Nov 1, 2025. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
Timberwolves’ Jaden McDaniels on Lakers’ center-less lineups after Minnesota’s Game 1 win:

“If [Jaxson Hayes] isn’t out there, I’m basically the tallest person out there. I don’t think no one call really rim protect me because Jaxson Hayes wasn’t on the court.”

Jaden McDaniels on Jaxson Hayes, Apr 20, 2025. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes’ ankle injury:

“Disappointed. Feel for Jaxson, especially after the last two games he had for us.”

JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes, Nov 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
JJ Redick on the NBA reopening its investigation into a 2021 domestic incident with Jaxson Hayes:

“We're obviously aware that the investigation has been reopened and we're going to cooperate fully. But other than that, I'm not going to have another comment on that.”

JJ Redick on Jaxson Hayes, Nov 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
“I was confused a lot. I was sliding back into the four during some possessions [and I heard], ‘AD, run corner!’ I forgot. So, it was good. Still figuring things out. Talking with the coaches and Jaxson and C-Wood about some things that I did with DeMarcus [Cousins] and Julius [Randle] back in New Orleans. So, it’s been good.”

Anthony Davis on DeMarcus Cousins, Julius Randle, Christian Wood, Jaxson Hayes, Oct 6, 2023. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Willie Green on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
Christian Clark:Willie Green said Jaxson Hayes has been diving and popping off of screens, but more the former than the latter.

“It’s a huge weapon to have. Someone like Jaxson, who’s 7 feet, runs like a guard,”

Willie Green on Jaxson Hayes, Oct 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Jaxson Hayes
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy on Jaxson Hayes going 3/3 from the three point line tonight:

“(Shrugs) usually he'll shoot one in a game. To go three for three? (Chuckles) I don't know what to tell you.”

Stan Van Gundy on Jaxson Hayes, May 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.
